notes: Epoch AI per-model page for Gemini 4 Argon, re-read 2026-10-13 by curl; the benchmark results are parsed from the embedded page props (not read from rendered text). The 2026-10-07 read recorded Argon only in a claim because Argon was not a catalog model; values are unchanged at displayed precision, so this file adds structured rows with raw values and Epoch's effort tags plus the Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra comparison columns from the same page (Kimi K3 is also on the page and not stored). Epoch's 'Text Arena (Coding)' is its WebDev Arena benchmark; metric id epoch-text-arena-coding keeps the label. ECI is N/A. Recheck on or after 2026-10-20.

claims.statement: Epoch AI page for Gemini 4 Argon (released Sep. 30, 2026; closed weights; ECI N/A), values equal to the 2026-10-07 read at displayed precision, now stored with the page's raw values and comparison columns (Claude Opus 5.5 max, GPT-6 Astra max): Vending-Bench 2 $13,718 (Opus 5.5 $9,235, Astra $15,515), APEX-Agents 87.9% (81.3%, 75.1%), ProofBench 99% (100%, 99%), Blueprint-Bench 2 54.4% (51.2%, 49.7%), Furniture Assembly Benchmark 72.5% (83.3%, 80.0%), CritPt 27.1% (31.7%, 31.7%), SciCode 61.8% (66.9%, 56.5%), 'Text Arena (Coding)' 1679.5 (1820.3, 1800.3; this is WebDev Arena, see the Arena file), FrontierSWE (v2) 55.0% (62.3%, 65.5%), SimpleQA Verified 76.0% (72.2%, 75.6%). Epoch tags the Argon results gemini-4-argon_high for Furniture Assembly, SimpleQA Verified, WebDev Arena, SciCode, CritPt and FrontierSWE, and gemini-4-argon_unknown for Vending-Bench 2, APEX-Agents, ProofBench and Blueprint-Bench 2. Argon is the highest of the three on APEX-Agents, Blueprint-Bench 2 and SimpleQA Verified, ahead of Astra but behind Opus on SciCode, and behind both on CritPt, FrontierSWE, Furniture Assembly and WebDev Arena; on Vending-Bench 2 it is above Opus and below Astra.
